_comment: Models for the E1c copy-rate extension. tag = short label used in folder names and result tables. Fill the two NEWER ids with the current model of each provider at run time and the open-weight model with the id your OpenAI-compatible host uses (set OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL and OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY in ../.env). The first two rows are the E1 models and are rerun only on the NEW schemas (E1 already has them on the original five).
